scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Archive closed physical-reference fields, qualifications and diagnostics without accepting physical convergence.

extended-finite-raw-peak-boundary-diagno.scope: Locate every last-three-level raw peak and measure compatibility of its prescribed incident boundary tractions.
extended-finite-raw-peak-boundary-diagno.limitations: Diagnoses the exact recorded raw peaks and original boundary law on the latest three meshes. A single symmetric stress tensor requires n_i dot t_j = n_j dot t_i. Measured incompatibility concerns continuity of one stress tensor at that boundary vertex. It does not prove a stress singularity or continuum peak growth, and zero local defect does not exclude other singularities. Normal-only traces are algebraic controls only, not replacement physical loads. Original full fields, raw maxima, radii, loads and numerical budgets remain unchanged.

pending_work_excluded_from_successful_ev: Fixed-boundary volume refinement with unchanged physical loads and independent full fields.

limitations: All90 original finest-three-level global peaks and values remain exact. Boundary distance, topological incident faces, true outward normals, original prescribed tractions and symmetric-tensor compatibility are measured. Manufactured symmetric-stress and normal-only controls pass. Algebraic compatibility concerns a single continuous symmetric stress tensor at a boundary vertex and proves neither boundedness nor singularity of the elasticity solution. Several largest unresolved convex/cavity peaks are subsurface, so local boundary-vertex incompatibility alone does not explain their measured raw-peak changes. Zero new equilibrium states and no physical tail acceptance. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
